title: AI Router CC-knowledge response v1
description: Produced by POST /api/v1/cc/knowledge (Commit C2b), authenticated via AI_ROUTER_CC_TOKEN. schemaVersion is a separate counter from cc-summary (1.0), cc-status (1.0) and the core router schema (2.0). `sources` is always built server-side from the RAG search results the model actually cited (validated against the results offered for this request), never parsed out of the model's free text - see orchestrator/cc-knowledge-handler.js.

state.description: ok: an answer was produced with at least one grounding source (context and/or knowledge). partial: an answer was produced despite one of the two grounding sources being unavailable. unavailable: no answer was produced (Ollama failure, or neither context nor knowledge available at all).

answer.description: Null only when state is 'unavailable'. Non-null and non-empty for 'ok' and 'partial'.

systemContextState.description: Whether the request included a validated Command-Center context object. Partial availability within the context itself (e.g. freshness: 'unknown') is expressed inside the context fields, not as a third value here.

sourceDoc.description: Relative FELIX_SYSTEM vault path only - never an absolute path or an internal index file path.
